rendered:
In the LDA of the concentration-gradient data, the strains split into fully and partially discriminated groups.

Fully distinguishable (no cluster overlap): P. aeruginosa, E. coli, E. sakazakii, L. monocytogenes, and E. faecium[1]. The paper cites Fig. 3e-h, Fig. S18a, Tables S4-S8[2] for this (Fig. 3[3]).

Partially discriminated (overlapping clusters): S. typhimurium and S. aureus[4], shown in Fig. S18b-c of the supplement.

As a further check, the paper reports that Blind tests were performed on four strains at unknown concentrations, which delivered 100% classification accuracy[5].
